title: cytisus decumbens var. glabratus
intro:
Cytisus decumbens var. glabratus, commonly known as Spotted Broom, is a variety of the broom plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including bronchitis, coughs, and colds, due to its rich source of bioactive constituents. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus decumbens var. glabratus include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in relieving respiratory issues and soothing irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
